R040-08.notes: Counting each line of dialogue as its own paragraph, paras 8 and 10 are correct. 'Nice work. Not the way I'd have done the clamps', said to Ruth, implies he knows she did it. The challenge for next year restores the rivalry. A, B and D are contradicted.

R040-10.notes: She writes the date on a clean page and answers 'You can try'. A is contradicted. B goes too far. C is ruled out by her deflection in para 9.
